description: The user's link tree pages: shareable single-page URLs for a CV, email signature, or job application, with per-link view/click tracking so recruiter engagement is measurable. Without a slug: all of the user's link trees (each with its id and slug). With a slug: that page's content plus its engagement data (views, clicks per link), which answers "has anyone looked at my link tree?".

slug.description: Fetch one link tree in full by its public slug (with engagement data). Omit to list all of the user's link trees.

name: get_linktrees
title: View Link Trees
